data.indexCnDesc: 中证港股通综合指数选取符合港股通资格的上市公司证券作为样本，以反映港股通范围内上市公司的整体表现。
data.indexEnDesc: CSI HK Connect Composite Index selects eligible common equity securities listed on SEHK under Hong Kong Stock Connect as the index constituents, weighted by free float market cap. The index is designed to reflect the market performance of eligible HK equity securities under Hong Kong Stock Connect.
